title: Flatten Array
description:
Write a function that flattens a nested array into a single-level array. The array can be nested to any depth.

Example:
- Input: [1, [2, [3, 4], 5], 6] → Output: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
- Input: [[1, 2], [3, [4, 5]]] → Output: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
hints: Check each item: if it's an array, recursively flatten it. If not, add it directly.
Use Array.isArray() to check if an element is an array.
